sections.heading: Intro
sections.content_markdown:
Layer 1 defines session-shapes that compose with Layer 4 (goal direction), Layer 5 (coupling), and Layer 8 (exercise library) at match-time. Each template specifies WHAT a session looks like (warm-up → main → accessory → conditioning → cooldown) and the RULES for filling each slot from Layer 8, but NOT specific exercise choices — those are resolved by the Program Designer per user state (archetype, equipment, mobility, fatigue, asymmetry).
Strength sessions follow a fixed 6-phase structure: Movement Prep → Superset A (Main compound) → Superset B (Unilateral / Core) → Superset C (Pump / Finisher) → Conditioning (optional) → Cooldown/Recovery. Mobility and Run sessions follow their own protocols but always end with Cooldown/Recovery.

sections.heading: Cooldown/Recovery (shared · every session · 20–30 min)
sections.content_markdown:
Shared component, not a slot. Fixed protocol regardless of template.
Mobility holds · breathing · light walking
Sauna 20 min + 2 min cold immersion (3–4×/week per Framework)

entries.heading: Lower Posterior
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: B1 General strength · B3 Strength endurance · C4 Hybrid athlete · C9 Team sport season prep · G1 Glute development. Frequency: 1×/week in a 4-day split, or 2×/week in a 6-day high-frequency split. Archetypes: hybrid trainer, returning athlete (Phase 3+), strength-focused user.
**Focus**: Posterior chain strength, mechanical load
**Shape**:
*Movement Prep* (5–10 min): Generic dynamic + posterior chain activation (Cossack Squat · Jefferson Curl · Dead Hang)
*Superset A — Primary compound* (15–20 min): Compound hinge ↔ Hip-dominant accessory
*Superset B — Unilateral / Core* (12–15 min): Unilateral hinge or split-stance ↔ Anti-rotation core
*Superset C — Pump / Finisher* (10–12 min): Hamstring/glute isolation ↔ Anti-extension core
*Conditioning* (optional): Zone 2 · 45 min · HR 115–125 bpm
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Slot rules**:
*Compound hinge*: Layer 8 Cluster 1 #5–#8 (Conventional/Sumo/Trap Bar deadlift) OR #7 RDL. Select per mobility, equipment, asymmetry status.
*Hip-dominant accessory*: Layer 8 Cluster 2 #21 Hip Thrust OR #25 Cable Pull-Through.
*Unilateral hinge or split-stance*: Cluster 2 #22 Single-Leg Hip Thrust · #23 Single-Leg RDL · #27 BSS · #28 Walking Lunge · #29 Reverse Lunge.
*Core (Superset B)*: Cluster 2 #48 Plank · #49 Side Plank · #50 Pallof Press (anti-rotation / anti-lateral-flexion).
*Hamstring/glute iso*: Cluster 2 #32 Nordic Hamstring Curl (advanced) OR #26 Glute Bridge (regression) OR #24 Good Morning (intermediate, low-back-loaded).
*Core (Superset C)*: Cluster 2 #52 Ab Roll-Out OR #53 Dead Bug (regression).
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 4×8 ↔ 4×10 · RPE 7. B: 3×10/side ↔ 3×45s · RPE 7. C: 3×12 ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Linear load increase wk 1→3 (MEV→MAV), week 4 consolidation. New macrocycle: rotate compound hinge variant.
**Decision rules**:
Form break on compound hinge → drop load 10% next set, hold for the session, retest next session.
3 consecutive sessions with RPE >8 at planned load → deload week scheduled.
Posterior chain DOMS persisting >72h at session day → swap compound to lower-load variant (#5 → #7 RDL → #25 Cable Pull-Through).
Lower-back fatigue → swap hinge to hip-thrust dominant Superset A; skip Ab Roll-Out, sub Dead Bug.
---

entries.heading: Upper Push/Pull
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A2 Build muscle · A3 Body recomposition · B1 General strength · B3 Strength endurance · C4 Hybrid athlete · G2 Arm focus · G3 Athletic look. Frequency: 1–2×/week as part of split. Archetypes: hypertrophy-focused, hybrid trainer.
**Focus**: Shoulder/back balance, work capacity
**Shape**:
*Movement Prep* (5–10 min): Generic dynamic + shoulder activation (Scap Push-Up · Band Pull-Apart · Hang Hold)
*Superset A — Primary compound* (15–20 min): Compound horizontal press ↔ Compound horizontal pull
*Superset B — Vertical / Shoulder* (12–15 min): Vertical pull ↔ Shoulder lateral iso
*Superset C — Pump / Finisher* (10–12 min): Biceps iso ↔ Triceps iso
*Conditioning*: none
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Slot rules**:
*Compound horizontal press*: Cluster 1 #9 Bench Press · #10 Incline Bench · #11 Close-Grip Bench OR Cluster 2 #34 DB Bench Press · #36 Push-Up (regression/variation).
*Compound horizontal pull*: Cluster 1 #14 Barbell Row · #15 Pendlay Row · #16 T-Bar Row OR Cluster 2 #37 DB Row One-Arm · #38 Inverted Row.
*Vertical pull*: Cluster 1 #17 Pull-up · #18 Chin-up · #19 Weighted Pull-up (scaled per user capacity).
*Shoulder lateral iso*: Cluster 2 #40 Lateral Raise OR #39 Face Pull (postural alternative).
*Biceps iso*: Cluster 2 #42 Barbell Curl · #43 DB Curl · #44 Hammer Curl.
*Triceps iso*: Cluster 2 #45 Tricep Pushdown · #46 Overhead Tricep Extension · #47 Skull Crusher.
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 4×10 ↔ 4×10 · RPE 7–8. B: 3×10 ↔ 3×15 · RPE 7. C: 3×12 ↔ 3×12 · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Load progression wk 1→3 on Superset A; rep progression on Superset B (pull-up reps add); volume progression on Superset C (sets 3→4 across mesocycle).
**Decision rules**:
Pull-up rep target missed 2 sessions → swap to assisted pull-up variant or scale via body angle (#38 Inverted Row).
Shoulder discomfort during press → swap to neutral-grip variant (#35 DB Shoulder Press) or angle change.
Elbow discomfort in arm-iso → swap to neutral-grip variants (#44 Hammer Curl); reduce Superset C volume by 1 set.
RPE >8 on Superset A for 3 sessions → deload week scheduled.
---

entries.heading: Lower Anterior
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A2 Build muscle · B1 General strength · B2 Strength peak · C4 Hybrid athlete · C9 Team sport season prep · G3 Athletic look. Frequency: 1×/week in a 4-day split, or 2×/week in a 6-day high-frequency split. Archetypes: hypertrophy-focused, strength-focused, hybrid trainer.
**Focus**: Quad dominance, anterior chain hypertrophy
**Shape**:
*Movement Prep* (5–10 min): Generic dynamic + ankle/hip mobility (Deep Squat Hold · Hip Flexor Stretch · Ankle Circles)
*Superset A — Primary compound* (15–20 min): Compound squat ↔ Quad-dominant accessory
*Superset B — Unilateral / Core* (12–15 min): Unilateral squat or step-up ↔ Core anti-extension
*Superset C — Pump / Finisher* (10–12 min): Quad iso (Cluster 3 #58 Leg Extension) ↔ Core
*Conditioning* (optional): Tempo Bike/Row · 20 min · ~80% HRmax
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Slot rules**:
*Compound squat*: Cluster 1 #1 Back Squat · #2 Front Squat · #3 Overhead Squat (advanced) · #4 Box Squat OR Cluster 2 #31 Goblet Squat (regression).
*Quad-dominant accessory*: Cluster 3 #56 Leg Press · #57 Hack Squat · Cluster 2 #27 BSS · #30 Step-Up. Machine variants (Cluster 3) preferred for A1 Reactivator early phases, A8 Senior, and post-rehab users (no spinal compression on Leg Press, axial-only on Hack Squat). Free-weight unilateral variants (Cluster 2) for trained-user progression.
*Unilateral squat or step-up*: Cluster 2 #27 BSS · #28 Walking Lunge · #29 Reverse Lunge · #30 Step-Up.
*Core anti-extension*: Cluster 2 #51 Hanging Leg Raise · #52 Ab Roll-Out · #53 Dead Bug (regression).
*Quad iso*: Cluster 3 #58 Quad Isolation (Leg Extension) — primary. Pairs with Hamstring iso as Superset C antagonist superset.
*Hamstring iso (machine)*: Cluster 3 #59 Seated Leg Curl (preferred for hypertrophy goals per Maeo 2021) OR Cluster 3 #60 Lying Leg Curl (more widely available alternative). For E1 Knee rehab Phase 1, both are functionally interchangeable.
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 4×8 ↔ 4×12 · RPE 7. B: 3×10/side ↔ 3×12 · RPE 7. C: 3×15 ↔ 3×20 · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Load progression wk 1→3 on Superset A; rep progression wk 1→3 on Superset B; volume creep on Superset C (sets 3→4 across mesocycle).
**Decision rules**:
Knee tracking issue under load → swap to Goblet Squat regression OR reduce depth and retest mobility.
RPE >8 on Superset A for 3 sessions → deload week scheduled.
Quad DOMS persisting >72h → swap compound to lower-load variant; cap Superset B volume at 2 sets.
Pre-existing E1 (knee rehab) flag → swap Walking Lunge to Reverse Lunge or Step-Up (knee-friendlier).
---

entries.heading: Upper + Core
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A2 Build muscle · B1 General strength · C4 Hybrid athlete · C9 Team sport season prep · G3 Athletic look · G4 Posture rebalancing. Frequency: 1×/week as variation of Upper Push/Pull, or 2×/week in a 6-day split. Archetypes: hybrid trainer, athletic-look user, postural focus.
**Focus**: Shoulder volume, core stability
**Shape**:
*Movement Prep* (5–10 min): Generic dynamic + thoracic mobility (Scap Push-Up · Thoracic Rotation · Dead Hang)
*Superset A — Primary compound* (15–20 min): Compound horizontal press ↔ Compound horizontal pull
*Superset B — Vertical / Core* (12–15 min): Vertical pull ↔ Core anti-extension
*Superset C — Pump / Finisher* (10–12 min): Shoulder lateral iso ↔ Hip flexion / hanging core
*Conditioning*: none
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Slot rules**:
*Compound horizontal press*: Cluster 1 #9 Bench Press · #10 Incline Bench · #11 Close-Grip Bench OR Cluster 2 #34 DB Bench Press.
*Compound horizontal pull*: Cluster 1 #14 Barbell Row · #15 Pendlay Row · #16 T-Bar Row OR Cluster 2 #37 DB Row One-Arm.
*Vertical pull*: Cluster 1 #17 Pull-up · #18 Chin-up.
*Core anti-extension (Superset B)*: Cluster 2 #52 Ab Roll-Out · #53 Dead Bug.
*Shoulder lateral iso*: Cluster 2 #40 Lateral Raise · #41 Rear Delt Fly · #39 Face Pull (postural alternative).
*Hip flexion / hanging core*: Cluster 2 #51 Hanging Leg Raise · #50 Pallof Press.
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 4×10 ↔ 4×10 · RPE 7–8. B: 3×10 ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7. C: 3×15 ↔ 3×12 · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Load progression wk 1→3 on Superset A; volume progression on Supersets B/C.
**Decision rules**:
Shoulder discomfort on Superset A → swap press to incline or neutral-grip DB variant.
Pull-up rep target missed → scale via #38 Inverted Row.
RPE >8 on Superset A for 3 sessions → deload week scheduled.
G4 (posture) primary goal → swap #40 Lateral Raise to #41 Rear Delt Fly / #39 Face Pull in Superset C.
---

entries.heading: Full Body
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A2 Build muscle (2-day split) · A4 Sustainable fat loss · B1 General strength (3-day) · B3 Strength endurance · C4 Hybrid athlete · C9 Team sport in-season. Frequency: 2–3×/week as a full-body split. Archetypes: time-constrained hybrid trainer, in-season athlete, low-frequency strength user.
**Focus**: Hybrid compound complex, work capacity
**Shape**:
*Movement Prep* (5–10 min): Generic dynamic + full-body activation (Cossack Squat · Band Pull-Apart · Hip Hinge Drill)
*Superset A — Complex* (15–20 min): Compound squat or hinge ↔ Compound vertical push
*Superset B — Unilateral* (12–15 min): Unilateral lower ↔ Compound pull
*Superset C — Finisher* (10–12 min): Posterior chain accessory ↔ Vertical pull
*Conditioning*: none (Full Body sessions ARE the conditioning)
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Slot rules**:
*Compound squat or hinge*: Cluster 1 #1 Back Squat · #2 Front Squat · #5–#8 deadlift variants · #7 RDL.
*Compound vertical push*: Cluster 1 #12 OHP · #13 Push Press OR Cluster 2 #35 DB Shoulder Press.
*Unilateral lower*: Cluster 2 #27 BSS · #28 Walking Lunge · #29 Reverse Lunge · #30 Step-Up.
*Compound pull*: Cluster 1 #14 Barbell Row · #15 Pendlay Row · #16 T-Bar Row OR Cluster 2 #37 DB Row One-Arm.
*Posterior chain accessory*: Cluster 2 #21 Hip Thrust · #25 Cable Pull-Through · #26 Glute Bridge.
*Vertical pull*: Cluster 1 #17 Pull-up · #18 Chin-up.
**Set/rep scheme**: A: EMOM 10 · RPE 7 (complex format) OR 4×6 ↔ 4×6 standard. B: 3×10/side ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7. C: 3×10 ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Complex difficulty progresses wk 1→3 via load OR EMOM density; volume held on Supersets B/C; week 4 reduces complex density.
**Decision rules**:
Complex execution form-failing in EMOM → switch to standard 4×6 format for that session.
Recovery markers (sleep, RHR, HRV) red 2 days running → swap Superset A complex for lower-stress single-lift; cap Superset C at 2 sets.
RPE >8 on complex for 3 sessions → deload week scheduled.
In-season (C9) primary → cap Superset A intensity at RPE 7, prioritize movement quality over load.
---

entries.heading: Mobility
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: D5 Mobility & joint health (primary) · G4 Posture/desk-worker re-balancing · All E-cluster (rehab, all phases) as compatible secondary · Compatible with any goal as recovery-day work. Frequency: 1–2×/week standalone, or 20-min add-on to strength days.
**Focus**: End-range control, recovery, ROM progression
**Shape**:
*Warm-up* (5 min): Light dynamic, blood flow
*Main flow* (40–50 min): Hip → spine → shoulder progression, end-range emphasis
*Conditioning* (optional): Zone 2 · 40 min · HR 115–125 bpm
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Slot rules**: Mobility flows are NOT slot-filled from Layer 8. Protocol exercises are fixed by methodology; load is user-scaled. The Program Designer selects which flow components apply based on the user's joint profile and current restrictions (per Layer 4 D5 / G4 / E-cluster).
**Set/rep scheme**: 90/90 Hip Flow · 10 min · Cossack Squat (loaded) · 3×10/side · Jefferson Curl · 3×10 (light) · PAILs/RAILs Hip Opener · 2× · End-Range Isometrics · 30s holds.
**Progression rule**: Load on Cossack Squat and Jefferson Curl progresses wk 1→3 within mesocycle. Isometric hold time progresses 20→30→40s across mesocycle. ROM measurements re-tested every 4 weeks.
**Decision rules**:
Pain >3/10 during any movement → skip that movement, log, route to E-cluster rehab consideration if persistent.
ROM regression session-over-session → reduce volume, hold current load 2 weeks, re-test.
Active E-cluster flag (rehab) → defer to that rehab's specific protocol; Mobility template paused or scaled.
---

entries.heading: Run
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: C1 Race prep short distance · C2 long distance · C3 Trail running · C4 Hybrid athlete · D2 Cardiovascular health focus (Zone 2 base) · C5 Cycling event prep (cross-training only). Frequency: 2–6×/week per goal phase. Subtypes (Z2 base / tempo / intervals / long run) selected by Layer 5 coupling per goal phase.
**Focus**: Aerobic base, cadence, fat oxidation (Zone 2 default; tempo and intervals per coupling)
**Shape**:
*Warm-up* (5 min): Walking pace, dynamic stride opening
*Main run protocol*: per session subtype (default = Zone 2)
*Cooldown* (5 min walking) + per shared protocol
**Slot rules**: Run sessions are NOT slot-filled from Layer 8. Protocol is set by goal phase per Layer 5 coupling logic. The Program Designer selects subtype (Zone 2 base / tempo / intervals / long run) per the user's macrocycle position and Layer 4 goal.
**Set/rep scheme — Zone 2 (default)**: HR 115–125 bpm · cadence target 165+ spm. Success metric: HR drift less than 5% over the run.
**Progression rule**: Per Layer 5 coupling logic. Time-on-feet progressive per macrocycle; pace at HR-cap improves week over week. Long-run distance progresses 10% rule per mesocycle.
**Decision rules**:
HR drift >5% in Zone 2 → reduce pace next session, hold for 2 weeks before progressing.
Cadence drops below 160 spm in second half → cap session duration, increase strength work emphasis (Lower Posterior or Full Body).
Calf/Achilles soreness persisting >48h → swap to bike, escalate to E5 (Achilles rehab) consideration if persistent.
Pre-existing E1/E5 flag → subtype restricted to walk-run progression per that rehab's protocol.
**Log per run**: distance · pace · avg HR · cadence · elevation
---

sections.heading: Comeback Templates
sections.content_markdown:
**Note on parallel structure with F4 Postpartum**: Comeback templates use the same Phase 1 Foundation → Phase 2 Loaded → Phase 3 Capacity taxonomy as F4 Postpartum reconditioning. The shape is intentionally parallel for cognitive consistency. However: F4 templates carry medical-clearance gates and pelvic floor monitoring that comeback templates do NOT require. Comeback users have no pregnancy/birth-specific physiological context; their reentry is structured around training detraining (5–15 year pause typical for Reactivator) and general capacity rebuild. The Phase labels are shared; the constraints are not.
**Bullseye personas**: Reactivator (35–50, training history but pause 5–15 years, body has changed, concrete frustration, respectful-adult tone in cues) · Returning Athlete (recent injury or shorter pause, retains pattern memory, faster reentry tolerable) · Hybrid-in-comeback (cross-modal background, wants strength + conditioning balance from Phase 1).

entries.heading: Reactivator — Phase 1 Foundation (2-day)
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A1 Get lean (Reactivator persona, Phase 1 entry) · D5 Mobility & joint health (compatible secondary) · E7 Return-to-training after extended pause (primary fit). Frequency: 2 days/week with ≥48h between sessions. Archetype: Reactivator (training history + pause 5–15 years).
**Focus**: Movement re-acquaintance, low load, no soreness peaks. RPE-cap 7.
**Shape**:
*Movement Prep* (10 min): Generic dynamic + joint-by-joint mobility check (Cossack Squat bodyweight · 90/90 Hip Flow · Thoracic Rotation · Scap Push-Up)
*Block A — Lower + Core* (15 min): Hinge regression · Squat regression · Core anti-extension. NO supersets in Phase 1 — full rest (~90s) between movements.
*Block B — Upper + Core* (15 min): Push regression · Pull regression · Core anti-rotation. NO supersets.
*Block C — Mobility finisher* (10 min): 90/90 hip flow + thoracic rotation + ankle mobility
*Conditioning*: none in Phase 1
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Slot rules**:
*Hinge (Block A)*: Cluster 2 #26 Glute Bridge OR #25 Cable Pull-Through. NOT a barbell hinge in Phase 1.
*Squat (Block A)*: Cluster 2 #31 Goblet Squat (default) OR bodyweight squat if hip/ankle mobility limits depth.
*Core (Block A)*: Cluster 2 #53 Dead Bug OR #48 Plank (knee-modified if needed).
*Upper push (Block B)*: Cluster 2 #36 Push-Up — start at incline (hands on bench/wall), progress angle toward floor.
*Upper pull (Block B)*: Cluster 2 #38 Inverted Row — start at high body angle (near-vertical), progress toward horizontal.
*Core (Block B)*: Cluster 2 #50 Pallof Press (band) OR #49 Side Plank (knee-modified).
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 2×8–10 each movement · full rest ~90s · RPE 6–7. B: 2×8–10 each · RPE 6–7. C: flow 10 min, no rep targets.
**Progression rule**: Conservative. Weeks 1–4 hold load steady; progress via reps only (8 → 10 → 12 across mesocycle). Phase 1 → Phase 2 transition criterion: 4 consecutive sessions completed clean, no DOMS >48h, no joint flare-ups, user reports session feels routine. No load increases in Phase 1 if any session in the prior 2 weeks triggered a back-off rule.
**Decision rules**:
DOMS >48h after any session → drop next session's volume by 1 set per movement.
Form break on any movement → swap to deeper regression (Goblet Squat → bodyweight squat; Push-Up incline → wall push-up).
Missed session due to fatigue/work → do NOT double up; resume at planned next session, no make-up.
Sleep red 2 nights running → swap that day's session for mobility-only.
Joint discomfort >2/10 → swap that movement, log location and type, route to E-cluster consideration if it recurs 2+ sessions.
RPE creeping toward 8 at planned load → stop the set early; hold load 2 more weeks before next progression check.
---

entries.heading: Reactivator — Phase 2 Loaded (3-day)
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A1 Get lean (Reactivator persona, Phase 2) · A2 Build muscle (Reactivator secondary) · E7 Return-to-training (Phase 2). Frequency: 3 days/week, e.g., Mon/Wed/Fri. Archetype: Reactivator past Phase 1 graduation.
**Focus**: Introduce load and supersets. Strength patterns rebuild. RPE-cap 7.
**Shape**:
*Movement Prep* (10 min): Generic dynamic + targeted activation per session focus
*Superset A — Primary compound* (15–20 min): Compound hinge OR squat ↔ Hip-dominant accessory
*Superset B — Upper / Core* (12–15 min): Compound upper push OR pull ↔ Anti-rotation or anti-extension core
*Superset C — Pump / Finisher* (10 min): Unilateral lower OR upper accessory ↔ Mobility hold
*Conditioning*: optional Zone 2 walk 20 min · HR <125 bpm (recovery-tier, not training-tier)
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Day rotation across the week**: Day 1 hinge-emphasis · Day 2 squat-emphasis · Day 3 upper-emphasis with full-body hinge/squat at lighter load.
**Slot rules**:
*Compound hinge*: Cluster 1 #7 RDL (light load entry) OR Cluster 2 #25 Cable Pull-Through OR #21 Hip Thrust (loaded variant of Phase 1 Glute Bridge).
*Compound squat*: Cluster 2 #31 Goblet Squat (loaded heavier) OR Cluster 1 #2 Front Squat (technique-introduction at light load) OR #4 Box Squat (controlled depth).
*Hip-dominant accessory*: Cluster 2 #21 Hip Thrust · #26 Glute Bridge (loaded).
*Upper push*: Cluster 2 #34 DB Bench Press (introduction) OR #36 Push-Up (progressed angle).
*Upper pull*: Cluster 2 #37 DB Row One-Arm OR #38 Inverted Row (lower body angle from Phase 1).
*Core*: Cluster 2 #50 Pallof Press · #52 Ab Roll-Out (knee-modified) · #53 Dead Bug.
*Unilateral lower (Superset C)*: Cluster 2 #30 Step-Up (knee-height) · #29 Reverse Lunge.
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 3×8 ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7. B: 3×8–10 ↔ 3×10–12 · RPE 7. C: 2×10–12 ↔ 2×30s holds · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Linear load progression on Superset A wk 1→3 (~5% load step if RPE held at 7); rep progression on Superset B; volume progression on Superset C (sets 2→3 across mesocycle). Week 4 consolidation. Phase 2 → Phase 3 transition: compound lift loads at user-defined baseline OR 4 consecutive weeks at RPE 7 without back-off triggers.
**Decision rules**:
RPE >7 on Superset A for 2 sessions → hold load 1 more week, do not progress.
Joint discomfort during a compound lift → swap to regression variant (Front Squat → Goblet Squat; RDL → Cable Pull-Through) for 2 weeks, retest.
Sleep + RHR both red 2 days running → swap that session for mobility + Zone 2 walk only.
DOMS >72h after a session → cap next session's Superset C at 1 set.
Form break under load → drop load 10% for remainder of session, log; if recurs next session, regress the movement.
---

entries.heading: Reactivator — Phase 3 Capacity (3-day)
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A1 Get lean (Reactivator persona, Phase 3) · A2 Build muscle (Reactivator secondary) · B1 General strength (Reactivator path to B1). Frequency: 3 days/week. Archetype: Reactivator past Phase 2 graduation, full pattern memory restored, ready for capacity building.
**Focus**: Build training capacity on full compound patterns. Performance signals re-emerge. RPE-cap 8 on Superset A; 7 on B/C.
**Shape**:
*Movement Prep* (5–10 min): Generic dynamic + session-specific activation
*Superset A — Primary compound* (15–20 min): Cluster 1 compound ↔ Cluster 1 compound (antagonist pairing)
*Superset B — Unilateral / Core* (12–15 min): Unilateral lower OR upper ↔ Anti-rotation or anti-extension core
*Superset C — Pump / Finisher* (10–12 min): Hypertrophy accessory ↔ Mobility or core
*Conditioning*: optional Zone 2 · 30–40 min · HR 115–125 bpm
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Day rotation across the week**: Day 1 Lower Posterior emphasis · Day 2 Upper Push/Pull emphasis · Day 3 Lower Anterior + light upper (Full Body finish).
**Slot rules**:
*Compound (Superset A) — Lower Posterior day*: Cluster 1 #5 Conventional Deadlift OR #7 RDL OR #8 Trap Bar Deadlift, paired with Cluster 1 #14–#16 row.
*Compound (Superset A) — Upper Push/Pull day*: Cluster 1 #9 Bench Press OR #10 Incline Bench, paired with Cluster 1 #17 Pull-up (scaled) OR #14 Barbell Row.
*Compound (Superset A) — Lower Anterior + light upper day*: Cluster 1 #1 Back Squat OR #2 Front Squat, paired with Cluster 1 #12 OHP OR Cluster 2 #35 DB Shoulder Press.
*Unilateral*: Cluster 2 #27 BSS · #28 Walking Lunge · #29 Reverse Lunge · #30 Step-Up.
*Core*: Cluster 2 #50 Pallof Press · #52 Ab Roll-Out · #49 Side Plank.
*Hypertrophy accessory (Superset C)*: Cluster 2 #21 Hip Thrust · #34 DB Bench Press · #37 DB Row One-Arm · #40 Lateral Raise · #42–#47 arm iso (rotate per session).
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 4×6–8 ↔ 4×6–8 · RPE 7–8. B: 3×10/side ↔ 3×10–12 · RPE 7. C: 3×10–15 ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Strength block per Layer 5 coupling. Compound lifts progress 5% load per mesocycle if RPE ≤7.5 across the block. Week 4 consolidation. Phase 3 graduation = user-defined goal target reached (per Layer 4 Achievement markers) OR ready to transition to non-comeback primary goal (B1, A2 trained-user track, etc.).
**Decision rules**:
RPE >8 on Superset A for 3 sessions → deload week scheduled (or 50% volume Superset A for 1 week).
Joint discomfort recurring on a specific compound → rotate to alternate (Conventional Deadlift → Trap Bar; Bench → Incline; Back Squat → Front Squat).
Recovery markers red 2+ days → swap that session for Phase 2-level template OR mobility day.
DOMS >72h consistently → reduce Superset C volume by 1 set across the week.
User reports session feels "easy" 3 weeks running → progress load 5% even if RPE was 7 (sign of accommodation, not undershoot).
---

entries.heading: Reactivator — Phase 3 Capacity (4-day variant)
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A1 Get lean (Reactivator persona, Phase 3, higher-frequency variant) · A2 Build muscle (Reactivator) · B1 General strength · G3 Athletic look (Reactivator entry to aesthetics). Frequency: 4 days/week, e.g., Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri (back-to-back days tolerable from Phase 3). Archetype: Reactivator in Phase 3 with capacity for higher weekly volume, often A2/G3 secondary goal driving the bump from 3→4 days.
**Focus**: Higher weekly volume, body-part split allows recovery per region. RPE-cap 8 on Superset A; 7 on B/C.
**Shape**: Same Shape architecture as Phase 3 3-day; redistributed across 4 days as a 2-Lower / 2-Upper split.
*Day 1 (Lower Posterior)*: Compound hinge focus · unilateral hinge · core
*Day 2 (Upper Push/Pull)*: Bench + Row focus · vertical pull · arm iso
*Day 3 (Lower Anterior)*: Compound squat focus · unilateral squat · core
*Day 4 (Upper + Core)*: Vertical press + horizontal row · vertical pull · core/hanging
**Slot rules**: Inherit from Phase 3 3-day template; Day 1 = Lower Posterior slot rules, Day 2 = Upper Push/Pull slot rules, Day 3 = Lower Anterior slot rules, Day 4 = Upper + Core slot rules (see those existing templates' slot rules in Strength Templates section above; Comeback context applies to Used-by and selection emphasis).
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 4×6–8 ↔ 4×6–8 · RPE 7–8. B: 3×10/side ↔ 3×10–12 · RPE 7. C: 3×10–15 ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7. Total weekly volume ~25% higher than 3-day variant.
**Progression rule**: Same as Phase 3 3-day. Body-part split lets each region recover ~3.5 days between hits → tolerates slightly faster strength progression on lower lifts. Week 4 consolidation.
**Decision rules**:
Recovery markers red 2+ days → drop to Phase 3 3-day variant for that mesocycle.
Joint discomfort on back-to-back days (Mon→Tue or Thu→Fri) → insert a mobility day between, drop the 4-day variant for the week.
RPE >8 on Superset A for 3 sessions → deload week scheduled.
User new to 4-day frequency → trial 1 mesocycle (4 weeks), evaluate at week 4 review: continue OR drop back to 3-day.
Sleep + RHR red 2 days running → swap one strength day for mobility + Zone 2.
---

entries.heading: Returning Athlete — Phase 1 Re-entry (3-day)
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A2 Build muscle (Returning Athlete persona, Phase 1) · B1 General strength (Returning Athlete entry) · E7 Return-to-training (Returning Athlete fit). Frequency: 3 days/week. Archetype: Returning Athlete — has training history within last 1–3 years OR is post-rehab returning to pre-injury capacity, retains pattern memory, can supersets and load patterns sooner than Reactivator.
**Focus**: Re-establish pattern competence at moderate load. Supersets present from Phase 1 (vs Reactivator Phase 1 which excludes them). RPE-cap 7.
**Shape**:
*Movement Prep* (5–10 min): Generic dynamic + session-specific activation
*Superset A — Primary compound* (15–20 min): Compound (variant or load-scaled) ↔ Antagonist or accessory
*Superset B — Pattern competence* (12–15 min): Unilateral OR vertical movement ↔ Core
*Superset C — Pump / Mobility* (10 min): Hypertrophy accessory ↔ Mobility hold
*Conditioning*: optional Zone 2 · 20–30 min (light reintroduction)
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Day rotation**: Day 1 hinge + upper-pull emphasis · Day 2 squat + upper-push emphasis · Day 3 full-body lighter day with mobility emphasis.
**Slot rules**:
*Compound hinge*: Cluster 1 #7 RDL · #8 Trap Bar Deadlift OR Cluster 2 #21 Hip Thrust (loaded).
*Compound squat*: Cluster 1 #2 Front Squat OR #4 Box Squat OR Cluster 2 #31 Goblet Squat (load-progressed).
*Compound upper push*: Cluster 1 #10 Incline Bench OR Cluster 2 #34 DB Bench Press.
*Compound upper pull*: Cluster 1 #14 Barbell Row · #15 Pendlay Row OR Cluster 2 #37 DB Row One-Arm.
*Vertical pull*: Cluster 1 #17 Pull-up OR Cluster 2 #38 Inverted Row (if pull-up rep capacity is rebuilding).
*Unilateral*: Cluster 2 #27 BSS · #29 Reverse Lunge · #30 Step-Up.
*Core*: Cluster 2 #50 Pallof Press · #52 Ab Roll-Out · #53 Dead Bug · #49 Side Plank.
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 3×8 ↔ 3×8–10 · RPE 7. B: 3×10/side ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7. C: 2×10–12 ↔ 2×30s · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Load progression Superset A wk 1→3 (~5% steps if RPE ≤7); rep progression Superset B; volume progression Superset C (sets 2→3 across mesocycle). Week 4 consolidation. Phase 1 → Phase 2 transition: 4 consecutive sessions clean at planned load, user reports patterns feel "owned" again.
**Decision rules**:
RPE >7 on Superset A for 2 sessions → hold load, do not progress.
Pre-injury site flagged (E-cluster history) → apply that rehab's specific decision rules in parallel (e.g., E1 knee: swap Walking Lunge to Reverse Lunge; E3 shoulder: cap overhead work).
Joint discomfort >2/10 → swap that movement to regression, log, escalate if recurs.
Recovery red 2 days running → swap session for mobility + Zone 2.
DOMS >72h → cap next session's Superset C at 1 set.
---

entries.heading: Returning Athlete — Phase 2 Loaded (4-day)
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A2 Build muscle (Returning Athlete, Phase 2) · A3 Body recomposition (Returning Athlete) · B1 General strength · C4 Hybrid athlete (Returning Athlete with hybrid history). Frequency: 4 days/week split (Lower Posterior / Upper Push-Pull / Lower Anterior / Upper + Core). Archetype: Returning Athlete past Phase 1 graduation.
**Focus**: Full 4-day split. Cluster 1 compounds primary across all 4 sessions. RPE-cap 8 on Superset A; 7 on B/C.
**Shape**: Inherit shape from existing Lower Posterior / Upper Push-Pull / Lower Anterior / Upper + Core templates in the Strength Templates section above. Comeback-context overlay: see Slot rules below for which specific entries to bias toward, and Decision rules for Returning Athlete-specific back-off triggers.
**Slot rules**:
*Overlay on existing templates — Lower Posterior*: Compound hinge slot biases to #7 RDL or #8 Trap Bar Deadlift in early Phase 2; progress to #5 Conventional or #6 Sumo in late Phase 2 if technique holds.
*Overlay — Upper Push/Pull*: Vertical pull slot — biases to #17 Pull-up (assisted if needed) over weighted (#19 deferred to Phase 3).
*Overlay — Lower Anterior*: Compound squat slot biases to #2 Front Squat or #4 Box Squat in early Phase 2; progress to #1 Back Squat in late Phase 2.
*Overlay — Upper + Core*: Same as base template; core slot favors anti-extension (#52 Ab Roll-Out) over hanging (#51 Hanging Leg Raise) until grip strength rebuilds.
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 4×6–8 ↔ 4×6–8 · RPE 7–8. B: 3×10/side ↔ 3×10–12 · RPE 7. C: 3×10–15 ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Strength progression block per Layer 5 coupling. Compound lifts progress 5% load per mesocycle if RPE ≤7.5. Week 4 consolidation. Phase 2 → Phase 3 transition: pre-pause baseline reached on 2+ compound lifts OR user-defined Phase 2 target met (per Layer 4 Achievement markers).
**Decision rules**:
RPE >8 on Superset A for 3 sessions → deload week scheduled.
Pre-injury site DOMS or joint sensitivity → apply that rehab's decision rules in parallel; do not "push through" injury-history zones.
Recovery markers red 2+ days → drop to 3-day Reactivator Phase 3 template for the week.
Volume tolerance unclear → start at 3×8 instead of 4×6, progress to 4×6 across the first 2 mesocycles.
User reports feeling "behind" mental tape of pre-pause self → log, do not adjust program; this is normal Returning Athlete psychology and resolves with capacity rebuild, not with faster progression.
---

entries.heading: Returning Athlete — Phase 3 Capacity (4-day)
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A2 Build muscle (Returning Athlete, Phase 3) · A3 Body recomposition · B1 General strength · B2 Strength peak (Returning Athlete entry) · C4 Hybrid athlete · G3 Athletic look. Frequency: 4 days/week split. Archetype: Returning Athlete with restored capacity, ready for full performance demand.
**Focus**: Performance demand at full capacity. RPE-cap 8.5 on Superset A; 7–8 on B/C. Hypertrophy or strength bias per user's primary goal.
**Shape**: Inherit shape from existing Lower Posterior / Upper Push-Pull / Lower Anterior / Upper + Core templates. Phase 3 means the Comeback context falls away and the user is on the trained-user templates with comeback-history awareness — this template is effectively the bridge from comeback cluster to general-population templates.
**Slot rules**:
*Overlay on existing templates — all compound slots*: Full Cluster 1 access (#1–#19) per user preference and equipment. Cluster 2 compound substitutes only for variation or scaling on specific days.
*Overlay — Vertical pull*: Cluster 1 #19 Weighted Pull-up unlocks if bodyweight pull-up capacity ≥8 reps clean.
*Overlay — Core*: Full Cluster 2 #48–#53 access.
*Overlay — Hypertrophy accessories*: Full Cluster 2 access (#34–#47) per session emphasis.
**Set/rep scheme**: A: 4×5–8 (strength bias) OR 4×8–12 (hypertrophy bias) ↔ 4×6–10 · RPE 7–8. B: 3×10–12/side ↔ 3×10–15 · RPE 7. C: 3×10–15 ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Per Layer 5 coupling. At Phase 3 graduation, user transitions out of Comeback Templates set entirely and moves to general-population templates with the relevant primary goal (commonly B1, B2, A2, A3, C4, G3). This template is the last comeback-specific template.
**Decision rules**:
RPE >8 on Superset A for 3 sessions → deload week scheduled.
User reports training "feels normal" — no longer thinking about comeback context → flag for transition out of Comeback Templates at end of mesocycle.
Recovery markers consistent and strength progressing → continue current programming; do not over-modulate.
New asymmetry or pain emerging during Phase 3 → log, escalate to E-cluster consideration BEFORE returning to higher loads; Phase 3 is when pre-pause patterns can re-expose weak links.
Pre-pause baseline reached on key lifts → consider goal transition (e.g., to B1 General strength as new primary).
---

entries.heading: Hybrid-in-comeback — Phase 1 Foundation (3-day strength + light conditioning)
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A5 Major weight loss (Hybrid-in-comeback persona, Phase 1) · A1 Get lean (with hybrid background) · C4 Hybrid athlete (early reentry) · E7 Return-to-training (hybrid path). Frequency: 3 strength sessions/week + 2 light Zone 2 conditioning sessions/week. Archetype: Hybrid-in-comeback — cross-modal background (CrossFit, hybrid athlete, multi-sport), wants strength + conditioning balance from Phase 1 even at low loads.
**Focus**: Establish movement patterns AND aerobic base in parallel. RPE-cap 7 strength; Zone 2 only for conditioning (HR-capped).
**Shape**:
*Strength sessions* (3×/week):
*Movement Prep* (10 min): Generic dynamic + activation
*Superset A — Primary pattern* (15–20 min): Compound regression ↔ Hip-dominant accessory
*Superset B — Pattern + Core* (12–15 min): Unilateral OR upper movement ↔ Core
*Superset C — Mobility finisher* (10 min): Mobility flow
*Conditioning sessions* (2×/week, separate days): Zone 2 walk/easy bike/easy row · 30–40 min · HR ≤125 bpm
*Cooldown*: per shared protocol
**Day rotation**: Strength day 1 hinge-emphasis · Strength day 2 squat-emphasis · Strength day 3 upper-emphasis with light full-body. Conditioning days inserted between strength days (e.g., Mon S / Tue Z2 / Wed S / Thu Z2 / Fri S / weekend rest).
**Slot rules**:
*Strength — Compound regression*: Cluster 2 #31 Goblet Squat · #25 Cable Pull-Through · #26 Glute Bridge (Phase 1 entries match Reactivator).
*Strength — Hip-dominant accessory*: Cluster 2 #21 Hip Thrust (loaded but moderate).
*Strength — Upper push*: Cluster 2 #36 Push-Up · #34 DB Bench Press (light).
*Strength — Upper pull*: Cluster 2 #38 Inverted Row · #37 DB Row One-Arm (light).
*Strength — Unilateral*: Cluster 2 #30 Step-Up · #29 Reverse Lunge.
*Strength — Core*: Cluster 2 #53 Dead Bug · #50 Pallof Press · #49 Side Plank.
*Conditioning*: Zone 2 (HR 115–125 bpm) on bike, easy run-walk, or easy row. Distance/duration progressive per Layer 5 coupling; user history determines starting volume.
**Set/rep scheme**: *Strength* A: 3×8–10 ↔ 3×10–12 · RPE 7. B: 3×8–10 ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7. C: flow 10 min. *Conditioning*: 30–40 min Zone 2, 2×/week.
**Progression rule**: Strength: load progression wk 1→3 on Superset A; rep on B; flow time on C. Conditioning: duration progression first (30 → 35 → 40 min), then intensity (later phases). Phase 1 → Phase 2 transition: 4 consecutive weeks clean across all 5 sessions, no symptom flares, conditioning HR drift <5%.
**Decision rules**:
Conditioning HR drift >5% → reduce conditioning duration next session, hold for 2 weeks.
Strength + conditioning fatigue stacking (recovery red 2 days running) → drop one conditioning session that week.
Joint discomfort on any movement → swap to regression OR substitute that day's session with mobility.
User new to balancing both — feeling pulled in two directions → reduce conditioning to 1×/week for 2 weeks, re-evaluate.
DOMS >72h on strength → drop next strength session's Superset C; keep conditioning if HR ranges hold.
---

entries.heading: Hybrid-in-comeback — Phase 2 Loaded (4-day mixed)
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A5 Major weight loss (Hybrid-in-comeback, Phase 2) · A2 Build muscle (with hybrid background) · C4 Hybrid athlete (Phase 2 reentry) · B3 Strength endurance (Hybrid-in-comeback entry). Frequency: 4 mixed sessions/week — typically 3 strength + 1 conditioning-strength hybrid day, OR 2 strength + 2 conditioning + 1 strength-conditioning combo. Archetype: Hybrid-in-comeback past Phase 1.
**Focus**: Both strength and conditioning loads progress. Performance signals re-emerge (FTP, run pace, lift loads). RPE-cap 7–8 strength; Zone 2 to occasional tempo on conditioning.
**Shape**:
*Strength sessions*: Same as Lower Posterior / Upper Push-Pull / Lower Anterior / Upper + Core templates from Strength Templates section above. Comeback-context overlay applies via Slot rules below.
*Conditioning sessions*: Zone 2 base (default) · introducing 1×/week tempo OR threshold work per Layer 5 coupling (cycle 5 work).
*Combo session* (1×/week): Strength compound (Superset A only, single-pair) → 20 min Zone 2 transition → strength finisher (Superset C only). Total ~60 min.
**Slot rules**:
*Compound hinge / squat / press / pull*: Bias to Cluster 1 entries (Front Squat #2, RDL #7, Trap Bar #8, Bench #9, Incline #10, Pull-up #17, Row #14–#16) at moderate load. Cluster 2 variants for variation days.
*Conditioning*: Zone 2 default + 1× tempo per week. Run, bike, row, or ski-erg per user history.
*Combo session compound*: Cluster 1 compound at 70–75% of strength-day load.
**Set/rep scheme**: *Strength* A: 4×6–8 ↔ 4×6–8 · RPE 7–8. B: 3×10/side ↔ 3×10–12 · RPE 7. C: 3×10–15 ↔ 3×10 · RPE 7. *Combo* — Compound A pair: 3×6 · RPE 7. Z2 transition: 20 min · HR <125. Finisher: 2×10–12 · RPE 7.
**Progression rule**: Strength per Layer 5 coupling. Conditioning duration + intensity progressive. Phase 2 → Phase 3 transition: Cluster 1 compound loads at pre-pause baseline + conditioning targets reached (per Layer 4 Achievement markers, often C4 Hyrox readiness markers if that's user goal).
**Decision rules**:
Recovery red 2+ days → drop combo session that week; substitute with Zone 2 only.
RPE >8 on Superset A for 3 sessions → deload week scheduled (both strength and conditioning).
Strength and conditioning both stalling → reduce conditioning intensity (tempo → all Z2) for 2 weeks, retest strength.
Joint discomfort on combo session → swap to standard 4-day split (strength only) until resolved.
User reports "everything feels heavy" → check sleep/nutrition before adjusting programming; under-recovery often the cause, not under-programming.
---

entries.heading: Hybrid-in-comeback — Phase 3 Capacity (4-day balanced)
entries.content_markdown:
**Used by**: A5 Major weight loss (Hybrid-in-comeback, Phase 3) · C4 Hybrid athlete (Phase 3) · B1 General strength · B3 Strength endurance · G3 Athletic look (with hybrid-aesthetics goal). Frequency: 4 days/week balanced — typically 2 strength + 2 conditioning (with 1 strength session being a strength-conditioning hybrid). Archetype: Hybrid-in-comeback at full capacity, performance-mode demand.
**Focus**: Full hybrid performance demand. Both strength and conditioning at target loads. RPE-cap 8 strength; full intensity range available on conditioning per phase.
**Shape**: Inherit shape from existing Strength Templates (Lower Posterior, Upper Push-Pull, Lower Anterior, Upper + Core, Full Body) and Run template from Mobility & Conditioning Templates section above. Hybrid-in-comeback context overlay: weekly programming combines them per goal phase. This template is the bridge to trained-user hybrid programming (C4 primary).
**Slot rules**:
*Overlay — all slots*: Full Cluster 1 and Cluster 2 access per user preference, equipment, and goal.
*Overlay — Conditioning*: Full Layer 5 coupling logic applies (cycle 5 work). Subtypes (Z2 / tempo / intervals / long-run / long-ride / Hyrox simulation) per goal phase.
**Set/rep scheme**: Per the existing strength templates. Conditioning per Layer 5 (default Zone 2 capacity-build; tempo and intervals per goal phase).
**Progression rule**: Per Layer 5 coupling. At Phase 3 graduation, Hybrid-in-comeback user transitions to C4 Hybrid athlete primary OR specialist goal (B1/B3/A2/G3). This template is the last hybrid-comeback-specific template.
**Decision rules**:
Strength and conditioning both progressing → continue programming; do not over-modulate.
Recovery markers red 2+ days → drop one conditioning day that week.
Strength progress halts but conditioning progresses → consider transition out of comeback templates to dedicated C4 programming.
User reports comeback context "behind them" mentally → flag for transition at end of mesocycle.
New imbalance or pain in Phase 3 → log, escalate to E-cluster consideration before pushing loads; Phase 3 stress can expose latent weak links from the pause period.
Pre-pause hybrid baseline reached on both dimensions (strength target + conditioning target) → transition to C4 Hybrid athlete primary goal.
---
